name: Promotion Data 1
definition: Contain information related promotion program applied to the transaction.

Provider.name: Provider
Provider.definition: Identify the type of entity offering the promotion. P000-P999 reserved for private use, N000-N999 reserved for national use.

Type.name: Type
Type.definition: Type of promotion. Specifies the nature of the promotion being applied. examples, Discount, Cashback, Loyalty Points, BOGO (Buy One Get One), Deferred Billing, etc.

Description.name: Description
Description.definition: Detail description of the promotion, useful for display on receipts, statements, other customer facing or suppor function.

Code.name: Code
Code.definition: An unique code assigned to the promotion, such as a campaign code or offer ID. This enables systems to track, validate, and reconcile promotions across transactions and reporting.

Start.name: Start
Start.definition: Date and time when promotion begin.

End.name: End
End.definition: Date and time when promotion end.

RedemptionMethod.name: Redemption Method
RedemptionMethod.definition: Describes how the promotion is applied to the transaction.

Channel.name: Channel
Channel.definition: The channel through which the promotion is offered.

Category.name: Category
Category.definition: A classification of the promotion based on the type of goods or services involved.

Stackable.name: Stackable
Stackable.definition: Specifies whether this promotion can be combined with other promotions in the same transaction.

TermsURL.name: Terms URL
TermsURL.definition: A URL linking to the rules or full terms and conditions of the promotion.
